subjectMappings.subject: router switch
subjectMappings.mapping: a full-width band at the top filled with teal when on and neutral slate when off, holding a large switch, the word On or Off and one line on what it means

subjectMappings.subject: nested spend
subjectMappings.mapping: four icon cards with large numbers (today, this week, tasks, share to Claude), then the week area chart beside the provider bars and the tier bars

subjectMappings.subject: five literal statuses
subjectMappings.mapping: one soft tinted badge per raw status word in the history table

ground.source: a solid night-slate ground traced from the teal accent hue at L 0.17, cards one step lighter
ground.textSeparation: cards sit one lightness step above ground with a soft shadow and a hairline top edge; body ink at least 7:1

quietRegions.region: space around the switch in the top band
gap between the cards and the charts
row padding in the history table

palette.regionalAssignment: teal drenches the switch band when on, draws the week chart line and fill and focus rings; provider and tier bars step through teal lightness; statuses use recut green, amber, blue and red badges; everything else is slate ink

contract.materialLight: one light from above: cards carry two layered diffuse shadows as elevation 1, the switch band elevation 2

motion.decision: the switch thumb and its band color ease over 200ms; chart and cards do not move

expectations: at 1280px the switch band is the first region and the switch is the largest control
the teal accent covers the switch band and the charts only, under 20% of the rendered page
the history table shows each raw status as a badge in compact rows with body text at 14px or more
dark ground sits between L 0.14 and 0.22 with the teal hue trace
contract.title: Rustig en strak
contract.description: Donkerblauw en kalm: een brede groenblauwe balk met de schakelaar bovenaan, vier kaarten met grote getallen, rustige grafieken in één kleur en een compacte tabel.
